caption: The drawing features a single object: a glass jar with a lid, depicted within a thin rectangular frame that is centered on a plain, beige background. The jar is round and bulbous at the base, tapering slightly towards the neck, with a wide, flared rim. The lid is rounded with a knob handle at the top, both rendered in similar tones. The predominant color of the jar and lid is blue, with variations in shading and highlights suggesting transparency and reflections on the glass surface. The artist's name, "Erwin Schwabe," is inscribed in small print near the bottom right corner outside the frame. There are some faint marks and evidence of previous adhesive on the surrounding blank background outside the frame.
title: Rose Petal Jar
